highlights.title_zh: BrainFlow 修 NeuroPawn Knight 的 EEG 缩放假器：漏除 79.57，幅度差近 80 倍
highlights.title_en: BrainFlow Fixes the NeuroPawn Knight EEG Scale: A Missing 79.57 Divisor, ~80x Amplitude Error
highlights.brief: BrainFlow 合并 #867，修掉一个会静默放大信号的设备级错误：**NeuroPawn Knight 与 Knight IMU 的 EEG 采样此前用运行期 `float` 做缩放，漏掉了 79.57 这个除数**，现在两个读取器统一使用 `KnightBase` 上的编译期常量 `4.0/(32768-1)/12.0/79.57*1e6`（µV）。少除一个系数意味着同一段信号读出来的微伏值被系统性放大约 80 倍——不报错，但频带功率、阈值判断、伪迹与阻抗判定全部随之偏移。对用该硬件做过实验的团队，建议核对记录里的幅度量级（正常 EEG 多为 10–100 µV），必要时按正确系数重标定后重跑分析。BrainFlow 是跨设备统一采集库，这类修复也提醒：换设备前先做幅度合理性检查。

highlights.title_zh: Neurofeedback BCI：Flask 平台整合自适应难度、FBCSP＋SVM 与 MI/SSVEP 混合控制
highlights.title_en: Neurofeedback BCI: A Flask Platform with Adaptive Difficulty, FBCSP+SVM and Hybrid MI/SSVEP Control
highlights.brief: 新建仓库 neurofeedback-bci（2026-10-21）是一套完整的神经反馈研究平台，而不是 demo：分类上做**混合范式**——FBCSP＋SVM 处理左右手运动想象，再用频谱特征＋**LDA 门控**判断当前是 MI 还是 SSVEP；难度调节提供六种策略（阈值、滑动平均、Elo 式、规则式、表现区间、EEG 增强型）；管理侧包含受试者注册、实验员分配、会话历史与分析。工程栈也扎实：Flask＋SQLAlchemy/Alembic、LSL（pylsl）实时传输、认证 JSON API，还能内嵌 **Unity WebGL** 客户端，仓库含 Emotive/ 目录下的采集、预处理、训练与评估脚本。对要做「闭环实验 + 自适应任务」的团队，这是少见的、把实验管理与算法串起来的开源参考。

highlights.title_zh: EEGDash 修并发刷新时共享 sidecar 被覆盖，并让头部实测值优先于 sidecar
highlights.title_en: EEGDash Stops Shared Sidecars Being Clobbered During Concurrent Refresh and Prefers Header Values
highlights.brief: EEGDash 在 10 月 21 日继续加固 ingest：#490 修下载器的**并发竞态**——多个刷新任务同时写同一个共享 sidecar 时会互相覆盖，现在会保留共享文件；#491 把 digest 的取值优先级改为「**EDF 头部实测的采样率与记录数优先于 sidecar 里的近似值**」，此前 sidecar 的近似值会盖掉实测值，造成时长与采样率偏差。这两项都不是新功能，却决定入库数值对不对：采样率错一档，整个频率轴都错；记录数错一位，时间轴整体偏移且很难察觉。对依赖 EEGDash 元数据做批量分析的团队，升级后建议抽样比对几个数据集的头部与下载文件是否一致。

items.title_zh: BrainFlow 修 NeuroPawn Knight 的 EEG 缩放假器：漏除 79.57，幅度差近 80 倍
items.title_en: BrainFlow Fixes the NeuroPawn Knight EEG Scale: A Missing 79.57 Divisor, ~80x Amplitude Error
bullets_zh: #867：Knight 与 Knight IMU 的 EEG 样本此前用运行期 `float` 缩放，**漏掉了 79.57 这个除数**；现在两个 reader 统一使用 `KnightBase` 上的编译期常量。
正确系数为 `4.0 / (32768-1) / 12.0 / 79.57 * 1e6`（单位 µV）——缺了除数意味着同一信号读出的微伏值被系统性放大近 80 倍。
幅度错误会连带影响频带功率、阈值判断与阻抗/伪迹判定，且不会报错；用该设备做过实验的团队应重跑相关分析。
bullets_en: #867: Knight and Knight IMU EEG samples were scaled with a runtime float that omitted the 79.57 divisor; both readers now share one compile-time constant on KnightBase.
The correct factor is 4.0 / (32768-1) / 12.0 / 79.57 * 1e6 in microvolts — without the divisor the same signal reads almost 80x too large.
Amplitude errors quietly distort band power, thresholds and impedance/artefact checks; teams that used this hardware should re-run affected analyses.
items.brief: BrainFlow 合并 #867，修掉一个会静默放大信号的设备级错误：**NeuroPawn Knight 与 Knight IMU 的 EEG 采样此前用运行期 `float` 做缩放，漏掉了 79.57 这个除数**，现在两个读取器统一使用 `KnightBase` 上的编译期常量 `4.0/(32768-1)/12.0/79.57*1e6`（µV）。少除一个系数意味着同一段信号读出来的微伏值被系统性放大约 80 倍——不报错，但频带功率、阈值判断、伪迹与阻抗判定全部随之偏移。对用该硬件做过实验的团队，建议核对记录里的幅度量级（正常 EEG 多为 10–100 µV），必要时按正确系数重标定后重跑分析。BrainFlow 是跨设备统一采集库，这类修复也提醒：换设备前先做幅度合理性检查。
items.brief_en: BrainFlow merged #867 fixing a silently amplified signal: NeuroPawn Knight and Knight IMU EEG samples were scaled with a runtime float that omitted the 79.57 divisor, and both readers now use one compile-time constant (4.0/(32768-1)/12.0/79.57*1e6 uV). Missing a divisor scales readings up nearly 80x, quietly shifting band power, thresholds and artefact checks.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #867: "Knight and Knight IMU EEG samples were scaled with a runtime `float` that omitted the `79.57` divisor. Both readers now use one compile-time constant on `KnightBase`: static constexpr double eeg_scale = 4.0 / (32768.0 - 1.0) / 12.0 / 79.57 * 1000000.0; // uV". Merged 2026-10-21T19:52Z.
items.why_valuable: 设备缩放系数漏除数会让整段信号放大约 80 倍，频带功率与阈值全部偏移。

items.title_zh: Neurofeedback BCI：Flask 平台整合自适应难度、FBCSP＋SVM 与 MI/SSVEP 混合控制
items.title_en: Neurofeedback BCI: A Flask Platform with Adaptive Difficulty, FBCSP+SVM and Hybrid MI/SSVEP Control
bullets_zh: 混合分类：FBCSP＋SVM 做左右手运动想象，另有频谱特征＋**LDA 门控**在 MI 与 SSVEP 之间切换。
自适应难度有六种策略（阈值、滑动平均、Elo 式、规则式、表现区间、EEG 增强型），并带受试者注册、实验员分配、会话历史与分析。
工程栈完整：Flask＋SQLAlchemy/Alembic 迁移、LSL(pylsl) 实时传输、认证 JSON API 与**内嵌 Unity WebGL** 客户端；含 Emotive/ 采集与训练脚本。
bullets_en: Hybrid classification: FBCSP with SVM for left/right motor imagery, plus spectral features and an LDA gate switching between MI and SSVEP.

Six adaptive-difficulty strategies (threshold, moving average, Elo-inspired, rule-based, performance zone, EEG-enhanced) with participant registration, experimenter assignment, session history and analytics.
A complete stack: Flask with SQLAlchemy/Alembic migrations, LSL (pylsl) transport, authenticated JSON APIs and an embedded Unity WebGL client, plus Emotive/ acquisition and training scripts.
items.brief: 新建仓库 neurofeedback-bci（2026-10-21）是一套完整的神经反馈研究平台，而不是 demo：分类上做**混合范式**——FBCSP＋SVM 处理左右手运动想象，再用频谱特征＋**LDA 门控**判断当前是 MI 还是 SSVEP；难度调节提供六种策略（阈值、滑动平均、Elo 式、规则式、表现区间、EEG 增强型）；管理侧包含受试者注册、实验员分配、会话历史与分析。工程栈也扎实：Flask＋SQLAlchemy/Alembic、LSL（pylsl）实时传输、认证 JSON API，还能内嵌 **Unity WebGL** 客户端，仓库含 Emotive/ 目录下的采集、预处理、训练与评估脚本。对要做「闭环实验 + 自适应任务」的团队，这是少见的、把实验管理与算法串起来的开源参考。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-10-21, neurofeedback-bci is a research platform rather than a demo: hybrid classification with FBCSP+SVM for left/right motor imagery and an LDA gate between MI and SSVEP, six adaptive-difficulty strategies, participant/experimenter management with session analytics, and a stack of Flask with Alembic migrations, LSL transport, JSON APIs and an embedded Unity WebGL client.
items.raw_excerpt: README: "Adaptive difficulty: threshold, moving-average, Elo-inspired, rule-based, performance-zone, and EEG-enhanced strategies"; "Hybrid EEG classification: filter-bank common spatial patterns (FBCSP) with SVM for left/right motor imagery, plus spectral features and an LDA gate for MI versus SSVEP"; "Live EEG transport | Lab Streaming Layer (LSL), pylsl"; "Additional client | Unity WebGL". Contents include app/, config/, Emotive/, migrations/, models/, seed.py.
items.why_valuable: 把自适应难度、MI/SSVEP 混合门控与实验管理串成完整平台，可直接参考。

items.title_zh: EEGDash 修并发刷新时共享 sidecar 被覆盖，并让头部实测值优先于 sidecar
items.title_en: EEGDash Stops Shared Sidecars Being Clobbered During Concurrent Refresh and Prefers Header Values
bullets_zh: #490：并发刷新时共享 sidecar 文件可能被互相覆盖（下载器的竞态），现改为保留共享 sidecar。
#491：digest 改为「EDF 头部采样率与记录数优先于 sidecar 值」——此前 sidecar 里的近似值会覆盖实测值，导致时长/采样率偏差。
这两项直接影响批量入库的数值正确性：采样率错一档会让频率轴全错，记录数错一位会让时间轴偏移。
bullets_en: #490: shared sidecar files could be overwritten by concurrent refreshes (a downloader race), now preserved across them.
#491: digest now prefers EDF header sampling rate and record count over sidecar values, which previously could override measurements with approximations.
Both affect numeric correctness of bulk ingestion: a wrong sampling rate skews the whole frequency axis, an off-by-one record count shifts the time axis.
items.brief: EEGDash 在 10 月 21 日继续加固 ingest：#490 修下载器的**并发竞态**——多个刷新任务同时写同一个共享 sidecar 时会互相覆盖，现在会保留共享文件；#491 把 digest 的取值优先级改为「**EDF 头部实测的采样率与记录数优先于 sidecar 里的近似值**」，此前 sidecar 的近似值会盖掉实测值，造成时长与采样率偏差。这两项都不是新功能，却决定入库数值对不对：采样率错一档，整个频率轴都错；记录数错一位，时间轴整体偏移且很难察觉。对依赖 EEGDash 元数据做批量分析的团队，升级后建议抽样比对几个数据集的头部与下载文件是否一致。
items.brief_en: EEGDash kept hardening ingestion on Oct 21: #490 fixes a downloader race where concurrent refreshes overwrote shared sidecar files, and #491 makes digest prefer measured EDF header sampling rate and record count over sidecar approximations. Neither is a feature, but both decide whether ingested numbers are right: a wrong rate skews the frequency axis, an off-by-one count shifts time.
items.raw_excerpt: PRs merged 2026-10-21: "fix(downloader): preserve shared sidecars during concurrent refresh (#490)" 04:49Z; "fix(digest): header rate and EDF record count beat sidecar values (batch6 catalog…) (#491)" 14:02Z.
items.why_valuable: 并发竞态与取值优先级都决定入库数值，采样率/记录数错一位即整轴偏移。

items.title_zh: hmp 重构交叉验证模块：LOO 与 CV 共用实现，并引入伪 k-fold
items.title_en: hmp Rebuilds Its Cross-Validation Module Around LOO with a Pseudo k-Fold
bullets_zh: #334 为交叉验证单独建目录，让 LOO 与 CV 共用同一套实现，减少两套代码行为不一致的风险。
基于 LOO 改进出 **pseudo_cv**：不重复计算 PCA，并允许外部传入信息——在保持 LOO 精度的同时显著降低计算量。
该库面向（层级）置换与多宇宙式统计分析，交叉验证是其推断流程的一环，改动会影响统计结论而非仅性能。
bullets_en: #334 gives cross-validation its own module so LOO and CV share one implementation, reducing the risk of divergent behaviour.
It derives pseudo_cv from LOO: no PCA recomputation and external information can be passed in, keeping LOO-like accuracy at much lower cost.
The library targets hierarchical permutation and multiverse-style inference, so cross-validation is part of the inference path, not just performance.
items.brief: hmp 合并 #334，把交叉验证重构成独立模块：#334 将 LOO（留一法）与 k-fold 统一到同一套实现（此前两份代码容易行为不一致），并在 LOO 基础上改进出 **pseudo_cv**——**不重复计算 PCA**、且允许外部传入信息，在保持留一法精度的情况下显著降低计算量。该库用于（层级）置换检验与多宇宙式（multiverse）统计分析，交叉验证因此不是纯性能问题，而是推断流程的一环：实现若与 LOO 不一致，统计结论也会变。对做多重比较、模型不确定性分析的 EEG/MEG 研究者，这类改动值得跟进并核对结论是否稳定。
items.brief_en: hmp merged #334 restructuring cross-validation into its own module so LOO and k-fold share one implementation, then derived pseudo_cv from LOO: no repeated PCA and support for externally supplied information, keeping LOO-like accuracy at far lower cost. Since the library serves hierarchical permutation and multiverse inference, cross-validation is part of the inference path, not just performance.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #334: "Proper crossvalidation model with LOO and CV — Created a proper folder for crossvalidation methods; Used common method between LOO and CV; Improved CV based on LOO (called pseudo_cv as no PCA recomputation and possibility to be informed); Adapted cumulative to CV (but more in next PR)". Merged 2026-10-21T14:48Z.
items.why_valuable: 统一 LOO/CV 并引入不重算 PCA 的伪 k-fold，统计结论一致性更有保障。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 显式导入 defusedxml.ElementTree 与 ipympl.backend_nbagg
items.title_en: MNE-Python Explicitly Imports defusedxml.ElementTree and ipympl.backend_nbagg
bullets_zh: #14430 显式导入 `defusedxml.ElementTree` 与 `ipympl.backend_nbagg`，避免某些环境下悄悄回退到标准库 XML 解析或缺少交互后端。
`defusedxml` 用于抵御 XML 实体膨胀/外部实体等攻击；一旦回退到标准库 `xml.etree`，解析不可信文件时的防护就失效了。
同日另有 #14443（ty 类型检查的 Python 版本调整）与 CircleCI 定时工作流问题自动建单等维护性提交。
bullets_en: #14430 explicitly imports defusedxml.ElementTree and ipympl.backend_nbagg so environments cannot silently fall back to the standard-library XML parser or lose the interactive backend.
defusedxml guards against XML entity expansion and external-entity attacks; falling back to xml.etree would silently drop that protection when parsing untrusted files.
The same day brought #14443 (Python version for ty type-check runs) and an automated CircleCI scheduled-workflow issue opener.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14430：**显式导入** `defusedxml.ElementTree` 与 `ipympl.backend_nbagg`。前者关系到安全——`defusedxml` 用于抵御 XML 实体膨胀与外部实体等攻击，若某些环境悄悄回退到标准库 `xml.etree`，解析不可信文件时的防护就形同虚设（MNE 会读取多种外部格式与元数据）；后者的显式导入则保证 Jupyter 交互后端稳定可用，而不是在某些环境里静默缺失。这类「显式导入」改动看似琐碎，实际是把隐式依赖变成可测试的约定。对在用 MNE 解析第三方文件或依赖 notebook 交互绘图的团队，建议升级后确认这两条路径仍正常。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python merged #14430 explicitly importing defusedxml.ElementTree and ipympl.backend_nbagg. The first is security-relevant: defusedxml guards against XML entity expansion and external entities, and silently falling back to the stdlib xml.etree would drop that protection when parsing untrusted files; the second keeps the Jupyter interactive backend reliably available instead of silently missing.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #14430: "BUG: Explicitly import defusedxml.ElementTree and ipympl.backend_nbagg — Follow up to …" Merged 2026-10-21T20:46Z. Same-day commits: "Bump Python version for `ty` runs (#14443)" 21:25Z and "Add CircleCI scheduled-workflow issue opener [ci skip] (#14441)" 16:10Z.
items.why_valuable: 显式导入避免静默回退到标准库 XML 解析，保住解析不可信文件的防护。

items.title_zh: Eelbrain 修带 filter_x 的预测器滤波
items.title_en: Eelbrain Fixes Predictor Filtering When filter_x Is Set
bullets_zh: #245 修「预测器（predictor）在设置了 `filter_x` 时的滤波」问题——滤波器未按预期作用于设计矩阵的预测变量。
Eelbrain 的回归/去卷积流程允许对预测变量做时间滤波以匹配数据滤波；若这一步没生效，模型与数据的时间特性不一致。
属单点修复，但影响所有用 `filter_x` 建模的分析，建议升级后重跑关键模型并与旧结果对比。
bullets_en: #245 fixes predictor filtering when filter_x is set — the filter was not applied to the design-matrix predictors as expected.
Eelbrain's regression/deconvolution workflows can time-filter predictors to match the data filtering; if that step silently does not happen, model and data no longer share temporal properties.
A small fix that affects every analysis using filter_x, so re-run key models and compare with previous results after upgrading.
items.brief: Eelbrain 合并 #245，修「设置了 `filter_x` 时预测器（predictor）滤波未按预期生效」的问题。在 Eelbrain 的回归与去卷积流程里，预测变量常需要做与数据一致的时间滤波（否则模型与数据的时间特性不匹配，估计出的响应形状会偏）；`filter_x` 正是这个开关，失效意味着设计矩阵没有跟着滤波。这类 bug 不报错、只让结果悄悄偏移，属于最难发现的一种。所有使用 `filter_x` 的分析都受影响，建议升级后重跑关键模型，并对同一条数据比较更新前后的回归系数与残差，确认差异在可接受范围内。
items.brief_en: Eelbrain merged #245 fixing predictor filtering when filter_x is set — the filter was not applied to design-matrix predictors as expected. In regression and deconvolution workflows predictors are time-filtered to match the data; if that silently fails the estimated response shapes drift. Anything using filter_x is affected, so re-run key models and compare coefficients and residuals.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #245 title: "Fix predictor with filter_x". Merged 2026-10-21T17:38Z. Repo: Eelbrain/Eelbrain; latest release v0.43.0b0 (2026-10-07).
items.why_valuable: filter_x 失效会让设计矩阵未随数据滤波，回归形状悄悄偏移且不报错。
